$comment: Adopted templates: every harness file that is a copy of a skill template (not a canonical file), keyed by harness path. A plain entry must equal the template with the skill placeholders filled in (verify-templates harness-adopted; --sync-harness refreshes it). An entry with "adapted" is changed on purpose, and the reason says how. "$scripts" lists harness npm scripts that the canonical package-scripts.json lacks yet.

$scripts.build:ios:sim: ios-simulator-build: its check-sim-setup requires this script and the scripts/build/* it runs. Not canonical on purpose: only apps that build for the iOS simulator have it, its multi-package form takes per-app arguments (--app-dir apps/<app>) that a byte-for-byte canonical script cannot hold, and ios-simulator-build's own npm-script rule checks it (quality-gates keeps per-skill tool scripts out of package-scripts.json).
$scripts.audit:network: privacy-and-store-declarations: its audit-repo audit-wiring rule requires this script (the template runner scripts/audit/audit-network.ts). A per-skill tool script, kept out of the canonical package-scripts.json like build:ios:sim; an app adds it to quality-gates.json verifyExtraSteps when it wants it inside npm run verify.
$scripts.audit:privacy: privacy-and-store-declarations: its audit-repo audit-wiring rule requires this script (the template runner scripts/audit/audit-privacy.ts). A per-skill tool script, kept out of the canonical package-scripts.json like build:ios:sim.
$scripts.build:android:emu: android-emulator-build: its check-emu-setup npm-script rule requires this script and the scripts/build/* and scripts/android/* it runs. Not canonical on purpose, like build:ios:sim: only apps that build for the Android emulator have it, and its multi-package form takes --app-dir.
$scripts.e2e:ios: e2e-maestro: its check-e2e-setup e2e-script rule requires this script (the template runner under scripts/e2e/). A per-skill tool script, kept out of the canonical package-scripts.json like build:ios:sim: only apps with Maestro flows have it, and ci-pipeline-and-gates' devices.yml calls it.
$scripts.e2e:android: e2e-maestro: its check-e2e-setup e2e-script rule requires this script (the template runner under scripts/e2e/). A per-skill tool script, kept out of the canonical package-scripts.json like build:ios:sim: only apps with Maestro flows have it, and ci-pipeline-and-gates' devices.yml calls it.
$scripts.screenshots:ios: e2e-maestro: its check-e2e-setup e2e-script rule requires this script once .maestro/screenshots/matrix.yaml exists (the template capture under scripts/e2e/). A per-skill tool script, kept out of the canonical package-scripts.json like build:ios:sim.
$scripts.screenshots:android: e2e-maestro: its check-e2e-setup e2e-script rule requires this script once .maestro/screenshots/matrix.yaml exists (the template capture under scripts/e2e/). A per-skill tool script, kept out of the canonical package-scripts.json like build:ios:sim.

app.config.ts.adapted: The harness config after the template: its own identity filled in, withI18n (the app name and purpose strings in every language from the catalogs, expo-localization supportedLocales), platforms [ios, android] (web-support is not adopted: DECISIONS §12), updates { enabled: false } (ota-updates is not wired), ios.privacyManifests from privacy-and-store-declarations PRIVACY_MANIFESTS, android.blockedPermissions (the storage pair, and SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW outside development: permissions-and-system-prompts), and every config plugin with its options: AdMob sample app ids per variant, the image picker without library or microphone permission, expo-notifications mode per variant (push-notifications APNS_MODE), expo-background-task (background-tasks) (expo-prebuild-and-config-plugins, ios-simulator-build).

contracts/analytics.json.adapted: No vendor yet: sdk "none", no endpoints, nothing collected (every build is off); consent.covers is that collection's fingerprint.

contracts/android-emu-build.json.adapted: Filled for this app: avdPrefix harness, appId com.example.harness, and permissions = the merged non-own permissions a production prebuild of the harness carries (37 from the native run on 2026-10-14) minus READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, which app.config.ts android.blockedPermissions removes in every variant.

contracts/architecture.json.adapted: Filled for the harness: testOnlyFolders lists the test build's folders (src/features/debug/, src/services/test-hooks/, src/services/debug-storage/, src/stores/debug-overrides/ from debug-menu-and-test-hooks; src/features/parity/ from design-visual-parity), and allowedImports holds one reasoned exception: the parity launch screen in src/features/debug/ imports the parity harness.

contracts/canvas-surfaces.json.adapted: This app has no canvas surface yet: "surfaces": [] instead of the template example surface.

contracts/e2e.json.adapted: Filled for the harness: the production id com.example.harness and an offline-only runtime proof (no API host yet; test builds install the network guard) instead of the template's allowlist with an example API host.

contracts/ios-sim-build.json.adapted: usageStrings lists the two purpose strings app.config.ts configures (camera, tracking; the image picker sets photosPermission false).

contracts/knip-ignores.json.adapted: The template's ten agent-folder ignore reasons unchanged, plus the harness reasons for every ignoreDependencies and ignoreBinaries entry of the harness knip.json (the pre-installed stack the app does not import yet, @formatjs/cli, macOS plutil); the $comment says so.

contracts/naming.json.adapted: The harness sets only extraE2eFolders (e2e-maestro's screenshot matrix folder .maestro/screenshots/, run by its own capture script) and keeps the library defaults for every other key instead of the template's example values.

contracts/navigation.json.adapted: Filled for the harness: the routes and debugRoutes add the test build's (debug) group (/debug, /debug/setup, /debug/parity), and protected names the canonical AppStack's Stack.Protected guard isTestBuild around (debug).

contracts/permissions.json.adapted: Filled for the harness: one notifications entry, asked from push-notifications' opt-in flow, with its copy keys in the catalogs.

contracts/persistence.json.adapted: Tables mode only: the harness has no save document, so the template "document" block is left out.

contracts/privacy.json.adapted: Filled for this app: every network SDK the harness installs (AdMob with UMP, expo-iap, Sentry, expo-notifications, expo-updates, the browser and sign-in packages) with the pods and Maven groups a production prebuild resolves and what each collects (expo-auth-session collects nothing: no sign-in is built; the push token is not linked, contracts/push.json requiresAccount false), instead of the template's empty "sdks"; the $comment says so.

contracts/push.json.adapted: No accounts in the harness: requiresAccount false; the comment says the registrar is a no-server stand-in until a push server exists.

contracts/screens.json.adapted: Filled for this harness: the template tasks entry unchanged plus a not-found entry (navigation-and-routing's screen) instead of the template Lists screen and its dialog, and no adSlot policy (the harness has no ad slot); the $comment says so. The test build's three (debug) routes are listed under ignoredRoutes with their reasons (debug-menu-and-test-hooks, design-visual-parity).

contracts/seeded-generators.json.adapted: This app has no seeded generator: "generators": [] instead of the template example generator.

contracts/stores.json.adapted: Filled for the harness: no write spans stores (crossStoreWrites is empty: no store holds repository rows, so resetAllData and removeList reach none), and the one OS mirror store; written once the test build's debug switches made a second persisting store beside the settings store.

contracts/visual-parity.json.adapted: Filled for the harness: launch ids of the harness preview build (harness-preview, com.example.harness.preview) and no frames, because no screen state has an approved design reference yet; only the capture wiring is adopted.

src/features/debug/test-only-gate.test.t.adapted: Lists the harness entry's members: the template's plus installNetworkGuard, createParityKit and ParityLaunchScreen.

src/features/parity/parity-plans.ts.adapted: PARITY_PLANS is empty: the harness has no design frame yet (contracts/visual-parity.json frames is empty and no screen state has a reference), so the template's demo plans (tasks, lists, the delete dialog) are left out.

src/i18n/catalogs/ar.json.adapted: Adds the purpose string app.config.ts reads that the template lacks (permissions.tracking.usage-description) navigation-and-routing's not-found.* keys (templates/src/i18n/catalogs/ar.json), the channel and notification keys of push-notifications and local-notifications, and the notifications permission copy (permissions.notifications.*, permissions.continue, not-now, open-settings, close) contracts/permissions.json names, debug-menu-and-test-hooks' debug.* keys (the debug menu and the debug link screen, test builds only), and leaves out the template's example keys tasks.delete.title and tasks.delete.body, which no harness code uses (scaffold-feature-screen's check-feature --orphans); the rest equals the template.

src/i18n/catalogs/en.json.adapted: Adds the purpose string app.config.ts reads that the template lacks (permissions.tracking.usage-description) navigation-and-routing's not-found.* keys (templates/src/i18n/catalogs/en.json), the channel and notification keys of push-notifications and local-notifications, and the notifications permission copy (permissions.notifications.*, permissions.continue, not-now, open-settings, close) contracts/permissions.json names, debug-menu-and-test-hooks' debug.* keys (the debug menu and the debug link screen, test builds only), and leaves out the template's example keys tasks.delete.title and tasks.delete.body, which no harness code uses (scaffold-feature-screen's check-feature --orphans); the rest equals the template.

src/services/create-root-kits.ts.adapted: The harness registry: the template's empty list filled with every kit the harness adopts, each with its skill's entry (crash reporting, analytics, push and local notifications), and an inline no-server push registrar until a push server exists.

src/test-only-entry.ts.adapted: The harness entry adds the test-only members other adopted skills export through the one gate: installNetworkGuard (privacy-and-store-declarations), createParityKit (design-visual-parity) and the harness's ParityLaunchScreen.

src/ui/motion/motion-moments.ts.adapted: screenPush.files also names src/app/(app)/_layout.tsx, the second Stack that takes useScreenAnimation().
